{"design":"# Plan: mimid-1wgh.5 — mimi-protocol (draft-ietf-mimi-protocol-06 wire types)

Approved by Mark 2026-10-17.

## Mark's decisions
- mimi-mls gains a `wire` module of newtypes (S0) delegating tls_codec Serialize/Deserialize to openmls types; MLS structures are not length-prefixed in protocol-06, so this crate must parse them. mimi-mls re-exports tls_codec.
- New pins approved: hmac =0.13.0, serde_json (exact). Committed Python fixture generator (stdlib hmac + `cryptography`) for franking/signature fixtures; tests stay offline.
- Pseudonymous rooms (§6, PseudonymousCredential): implement best guess; each invented part gets a decision record marked "invented, not from spec"; PseudonymousCredential allowed only in §6 rooms (exception to BasicCredential-only). Low-priority sub-issue.
- Incoming fanout: room URI comes from the /notify/{roomId} path (FanoutMessage body lacks it).

## Inventory
| Endpoint | Request | Response | § |
|---|---|---|---|
| directory | GET /.well-known/mimi-protocol-directory | JSON map | 5.1 |
| keyMaterial | KeyMaterialRequest (+TBS, signed) | KeyMaterialResponse (ClientKeyMaterial, UserCode, ClientCode) | 5.2 |
| update | UpdateRequest (HandshakeBundle, GroupInfoOption, GroupInfoRepresentation) | UpdateRoomResponse, UpdateResponseCode | 5.3 |
| submitMessage | SubmitMessageRequest | SubmitMessageResponse, SubmitResponseCode, Frank | 5.4 |
| notify | FanoutMessage (concatenated) | 201 | 5.5 |
| groupInfo | GroupInfoRequest (+TBS) | GroupInfoResponse (+TBS), GroupInfoCode, GroupInfoRatchetTreeTBE, PendingProposal | 5.6 |
| requestConsent / updateConsent | ConsentEntry, ConsentOperation | 201/404 | 5.7 |
| identifierQuery | IdentifierRequest, QueryElement, SearchIdentifierType | IdentifierResponse, UserProfile, ProfileField, FieldSource, IdentifierQueryCode | 5.8 |
| reportAbuse | AbuseReport, AbusiveMessage, AbuseType | none | 5.9 |
| proxyDownload | GET {url} | asset bytes | 5.10.2 |
Components (§10): frank_aad 0x0020 FrankAAD; 0x0021 FrankingAgentData (DR-3); participant_list 0x0022 ParticipantListData/Update (§7.5); room_metadata 0x0023 RoomMetaData/Update + Uri, UTF8String, RichDescription (§7.6).

## Encoding
TLS-PL for all bodies (§5, L997); directory is JSON (§5.1, L1020); no CBOR in this crate (franking inputs salt/sender_uri/room_uri come from mimi-content as inputs). optional<T> per RFC 9420 §2.1.1.

## MLS types needed from mimi-mls::wire
CipherSuite, RequiredCapabilities, Capabilities, SignaturePublicKey, Credential, HPKEPublicKey, HPKECiphertext, KeyPackage, Welcome, GroupInfo, MLSMessage (+ wire_format(), content_type()), ExternalSender, ProposalRef, AppDataDictionary, RatchetTreeOption, PartialGroupInfo; sign/verify/encrypt_with_label.

## Crypto computations and oracles
| Value | Definition | Oracle |
|---|---|---|
| franking_tag | HMAC-SHA256(key=16-byte salt, application_data) §5.4.1.1 | Python stdlib hmac -> hex fixtures |
| server_frank | HMAC-SHA256(hub_key, franking_tag || TLS(ServerFrankingContext)) §5.4.1.2 | same, context hand-encoded |
| franking_integrity_signature | SignWithLabel "FrankingIntegrityTBS" | hand-encoded TBS; Ed25519 deterministic -> Python cryptography fixed key |
| key_material_request_signature | SignWithLabel "KeyMaterialRequestTBS" §5.2 | same |
| GroupInfoRequest/Response signatures | "GroupInfoRequestTBS"/"GroupInfoResponseTBS" §5.6 | same |
| encrypted_groupinfo_and_tree | EncryptWithLabel(pk, "GroupInfo and ratchet_tree encryption", room_id, TBE) | TBE bytes by hand + decrypt round-trip; primitive covered by crypto-basics |
No hex in the draft. Fixtures: hand-written hex per struct with byte comments; negative tests (trailing bytes, unsorted AppDataDictionary per ext-10 §4.6, unknown select codes). phnx-im/mimi-protocol unusable as oracle.

## Layout
crates/mimi-protocol/src/{lib.rs, directory.rs, component.rs, key_material.rs, update.rs, notify.rs, submit.rs, group_info.rs, consent.rs, identifier.rs, abuse.rs, frank.rs}. Spec selects -> Rust enums; manual tls_codec only where a select needs it; open wire enums as u8 newtypes + consts; FanoutMessage::decode_all reads until input runs out (§5.5 L1921).

## Decision records (filed): P1-P17, P19, notify-room-URI; P18 replaced by Mark's "implement best guess" decision.
